# The Texas Observer

> Nonprofit investigative journalism organization covering Texas politics, civil rights, social justice, and accountability since 1954.

The Texas Observer is an award-winning nonprofit news outlet dedicated to in-depth reporting on issues affecting Texans, from border policy and criminal justice to education and environmental protection. The organization maintains editorial independence while advancing social justice through investigative journalism and cultural commentary.

## Key Topics

- Texas politics
- Investigative journalism
- Civil rights
- Border and immigration
- Criminal justice
- Death penalty
- Book banning
- Reproductive rights
- Environmental protection
- Labor rights
- Rural hospitals
- Police accountability
- Social justice
- Indigenous affairs
- Housing policy

## Core Organization

- [The Texas Observer: Investigating Texas Since 1954](https://www.texasobserver.org): Homepage for nonprofit investigative news organization covering Texas politics, civil rights, and social justice.
- [About the Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/about): Organization mission, history since 1954, editorial independence, and nonprofit transparency.
- [MOLLY National Journalism Prizes](https://www.texasobserver.org/molly-awards): Annual journalism awards honoring Molly Ivins legacy with national prizes for investigative reporting.

## Texas Politics & Government

- [Politics - The Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/politics): Topic archive on Texas politics, elections, primary races, and political analysis.
- [Loon Star State - The Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/loon-star-state): Political satire column by Ben Sargent on Texas politics and Republican commentary.

## Justice & Civil Rights

- [Criminal Justice - The Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/topics-criminal-justice): Topic archive covering death penalty, wrongful convictions, jail reform, and police accountability.
- [Civil Rights - The Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/civil-rights): Topic archive on civil rights, protest rights, police misconduct, and activism in Texas.
- [Border and Immigration - The Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/border-and-immigration): Topic archive covering border policy, ICE detention, deportation, and immigration advocacy in Texas.

## Policy & Social Issues

- [Education - The Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/education): Topic archive on education policy, book banning, school vouchers, and academic freedom in Texas.
- [Public Health - The Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/public-health): Topic archive covering abortion access, healthcare funding, opioid crisis, and Medicaid in Texas.
- [Environment - The Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/environment): Topic archive covering water crisis, renewable energy, pollution, and environmental policy in Texas.
- [Labor - The Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/labor): Topic archive covering workers' rights, wage theft, workplace safety, and labor policy in Texas.
- [Housing - The Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/housing): Topic archive covering housing policy, homelessness, short-term rentals, and property issues.

## Community & Culture

- [Rural Reporting Project - Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/rural-texas): Rural Texas reporting on water rights, hospitals, mental health, and community issues.
- [Indigenous Affairs - The Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/indigenous-affairs): Topic archive on Lipan Apache, tribal sovereignty, and indigenous peoples in Texas.
- [Culture - The Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/culture): Topic archive for arts, culture, community stories, and cultural traditions in Texas.
- [Extremism - The Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/extremism): Topic archive on white supremacy, neo-Nazi activity, and extremism investigation in Texas.

## Arts & Commentary

- [Photo Essays - The Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/photo-essays): Visual storytelling through documentary photography on border, justice, and social issues.
- [Reviews - The Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/reviews): Book reviews, film reviews, and cultural criticism with social justice perspective.
- [Poetry - The Texas Observer](https://www.texasobserver.org/topics/poetry): Poetry collection and archive from Texas writers with social commentary.
